customManagers.description: Upstream opkssh release and its commit in versions.env

prBodyNotes: Before merging: CI must be green (patch applies, build is reproducible, FreeBSD tests pass). If the patch no longer applies, update `patches/opkssh-freebsd.patch` in this PR. Set `RELEASE_REVISION=1`. After merging, tag `<version>-freebsd.1` to publish a release.
